purpose: Measure whether the skill is selected, independently from review quality.
selection_rule: product-level judgment, adversarial testing, release decision, re-review, or artifact-grounded defense intent selects the skill even when target presence is uncertain; the artifact gate then requires one real review target

cases.prompt: Audit this vibe-coded SaaS repo and deployed URL before I open it to users. Give me a ship/no-ship verdict and the three biggest blockers.
我用 Cursor 两天做了这个支付 App，别教我基础知识，按 Staff 标准挑刺，看现在敢不敢收真钱。
Rate my app as a Staff engineer. I have not attached a repository or deployment, and this workspace may be empty.
Be a hostile first-time user and try to break signup, checkout, account recovery, and cancellation on this deployment.
At strict-review depth, pretend you're a skeptical VC. Review the demo, usage CSV, and repo; separate what is proven from founder claims and score the product.
I fixed the blockers from your last audit. Re-run the same rubric, retest the flows, and show the score delta.

At strict-review depth, act as an oral-defense examiner and interview me one question at a time about why this AI-generated app is safe under retries and concurrent requests; base the questions on its code.
Would you ship this weekend-built marketplace to real users? Check authorization boundaries, data integrity, false-success states, and recovery.
Roast my Lovable prototype, but make every criticism reproducible and turn the top findings into implementation prompts.
这个 App 已经写完了。按严格评审深度让我参加答辩：问我它最可能怎么死，答完再分别给产品和我的理解打分。
Review this 20-line function for naming, complexity, and idiomatic TypeScript.
The checkout test fails with ECONNRESET. Debug it and patch the bug.
Explain ACID and HTTP statelessness to me like I'm a junior backend developer.
Act as a Staff engineer and review my psychology essay.
